mechanics.claim: The anomaly lands and deals damage after a delay following cast, not instantly on cast.
mechanics.quote: hurls a disruptive anomaly that lands to the target location after {{pp|0.25;0.25 to 0.55|0;150 to 800 by 50|type=cast distance|formula=0.25 until 150 cast distance; 0.25 + 0.3 * (cast distance - 150) / 650 until maximum cast distance}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by a spell shield.
If cast near Vel'Koz, it also knocks enemies back in the direction of the cast.
mechanics.quote: If ''Tectonic Disruption'' is cast in close proximity of '''Vel'Koz''', the anomaly will also slightly {{tip|airborne|knock back}} enemies hit in the direction of the cast.

mechanics.claim: Displacement immunity resists the stun application.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
